| `legalDomicileCountryCode` | string | ISO country code the company is legally domiciled in, which is not always where it operates. |
| `legalDomicileCountryName` | string | Country name of the legal domicile. |
| `descriptionShort` | string | One-line business description. |
| `descriptionLong` | string | Full business description. |
| `chiefExecutiveOfficer` | string | Name of the current chief executive. |
| `foundingYear` | number | Year the company was founded. |
| `ipoYear` | number | Year it first listed. |
| `sector` | string | GICS sector. |
| `industryGroup` | string | GICS industry group. |
| `industry` | string | GICS industry. |
| `subIndustry` | string | GICS sub-industry. |
| `reportingTemplate` | string | Which standardized statement template this company's financials map onto. |
| `cik` | string | SEC Central Index Key, when the company files with the SEC. |
| `marketCapUsd` | number | Market capitalisation in USD. |
| `primaryListing` | object | The primary listing: ticker, exchange code and name, and MICs. |
| `secondaryListings` | object[] | Every other listing of the same company on other exchanges. |
| `peers` | object[] | Comparable companies, each with the peer relationship, market segment and a prose reason for the grouping alongside the company block. |

| `reportingCurrency` | string | The currency the company reports in, before any conversion a caller asks for. |

| `earningsFilingDate` | string | Date of the next or most recent earnings filing. Served live. |
| `availableDatasets` | string[] | Which datasets Fiscal.ai holds for this company. Read it before spending a call on a capability it has no data for. |
| `financialPeriodsAvailable` | string[] | Which period types the financials cover, for example annual, quarterly, ltm. |

fscl.description: Fiscal.ai's stable company identifier, the `companyFiscalIdentifier` field. The only identifier that survives a ticker change or a relisting, so prefer it when carrying a company between calls.

companyKey.description: Exchange and ticker joined by an underscore: `NASDAQ_MSFT` for US and Canadian listings, or MIC code and ticker elsewhere, as in `XWAR_PKN`.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, for example MSFT. Only unique within an exchange, so pass `exchange` with it.

exchange.description: Exchange code for `ticker`, for example NASDAQ, or a MIC code for a non-US/CA listing.

cusip.description: CUSIP of the security. Licensed identifier.

isin.description: ISIN of the security. Licensed identifier.

figi.description: OpenFIGI identifier of the security. Licensed identifier.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key. Use when a company has no ticker, or after a rename.
